name: Cosplay Kanojo
source:
"My wish has come true. For one whole day the girl I like will do whatever I say."

An otaku with a cosplay fetish gets a full day of wish fulfillment with the girl of his dreams.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ146196.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
